input: Register for a half marathon in the spring

gold.taskTitle: Register for a Spring Half Marathon Race
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a half marathon race taking place in the spring.

questions.title: Which month in spring are you targeting to race?
questions.description: Determine the specific month or date range the user has in mind for the race.

questions.title: Do you have a specific city or region in mind?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location where the user wants to run the race.

questions.title: Have you run a half marathon before?
questions.description: Understand the user's experience level to gauge how much training prep context is needed.

questions.title: Is there a specific race you already have in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has already identified a race or needs help searching for one.

questions.title: What is your budget for the registration fee?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints that may filter race options.

questions.title: Do you need accommodations or travel arranged around the race?
questions.description: Determine if logistics beyond registration need to be planned.

questions.title: Is there a registration deadline you are working against?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure that affects how urgently registration must be completed.
